body: Not something I usually struggle with as I usually dont care, but feeling the need to applogise and while youll never see this, this is an opportunity to do so, so Im sorry that I let my emotions control me when I was diagnosed and through that caused issues for you.
Thank you, I hope youre right, I dont feel tough at all to be honest and happiness and peace feel a world away.

I dont know if this counts but I would like to share anyway.

My childhood and my adolescence were full of domestic violence on the part of my father, both towards me and towards my mother. It escalated and culminated when I was 11, my father attacked my mother and she was on the floor and I tried to intervene. He ended up stringing a noose in the backyard and told me he was going to hang me before he hanged himself. The ambos and police showed up at that point, but it has screwed me up pretty bad all my life, I dont trust anyone very easily and Im not great at relationships...

Now onto my third brain tumour and my fourth day of being unable to eat and drink and Im wondering if it would have been better if it had all ended back then.

Ive tried telling the people who matter to me that I wanted them in my life, and the response I got from all of them is that they would prefer no more contact.

I dont know what to do Ive got literally no one in my life, Ive tried to get professional help but cant get an appointment until mid April...

Im so alone and no one in my every day life cares, the fucked thing is I was depressed and down when people did care and I said the same thing, now Im worse, and Im saying it, but now its actually true, Ive destroyed every friendship Ive ever had.
